sources.snippet: Model Description This is an uncensored version of Qwen3.5-9B, processed using the Heretic method to remove the model's built-in refusal/censorship mechanisms through neural direction ablation.

sources.snippet: This is an uncensored version of Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B created with abliteration (see remove-refusals-with-transformers to know more about it). This is a crude, proof-of-concept implementation to remove refusals from an LLM model without using TransformerLens.
